I regenerated `REPORT.md` with the `write-report-md-project` reflex. The file is in the repo root, and I checked its contents against git.

It reports 3 commits on `main`, HEAD `92419d4`, no remotes, and the lines-of-code and largest-file tables. These match what git shows: three tracked source files under `src/` and `web/`, plus `README.md`.

Two things to know:

The current file has only the last commit, so I left it as generated. Regenerating the script to add the history would be the fix. I haven't changed the script.
- **"Uncommitted changes: 0" is slightly stale.** The count was taken before `REPORT.md` was written, so the new untracked file isn't counted. Git now shows `?? REPORT.md`.

I didn't commit anything.
